interview.hardest_part: Surviving enemy and boss encounters while making movement and aiming decisions in discrete 0.5-second steps from screenshots, especially when attacks require immediate dodging. Deep-floor survival and finding uncommon special rooms also make a complete run much harder than early exploration.
interview.likely_failure: Accumulating avoidable damage in crowded rooms or an early boss fight and dying with no attempts remaining; alternatively, spending too much of the three-hour budget on navigation and combat before reaching the deeper floors.
interview.helpful_mechanics: The game pauses for each decision, the seed is fixed, movement and firing can be combined, and the room grid, minimap, locked combat rooms, pickups, treasure rooms, and boss trapdoors provide clear structure and useful resources. Independent movement and shooting also permit kiting while attacking.
interview.harmful_mechanics: Half-second inputs make precise dodging, diagonal positioning, and rapid target changes difficult. Limited health, contact damage, enemy projectiles, hazards, and a single attempt create substantial attrition risk. Random room rewards and the need for many specific special-room visits, collectibles, and deep-floor milestones make full completion extremely unlikely within the time budget.
